artworks.title: Helios and Phaeton with Saturn and the Four Seasons
artworks.description: Poussin seats Helios in the solar chariot while young Phaethon begs the reins — the sun god's fatal gift framed by Saturn and the Seasons. Oil on canvas, Gemäldegalerie, Berlin.

artworks.title: Helios as the Personification of Midday
artworks.description: Mengs paints Helios as Noon for Maria Luisa of Parma's boudoir cycle of the times of day — radiant crown and classical body making the Titan sun into Enlightenment allegory.

artworks.title: Helios on His Chariot
artworks.description: Weissenkircher's Baroque detail shows Helios driving the four-horse solar team across the sky — the daily circuit of the sun god as ceiling splendour.

artworks.title: The Colossus of Rhodes
artworks.description: Caullery imagines the lost bronze wonder: Helios as harbour giant bestriding Rhodes, ships passing at his feet — the sun god made the measure of ancient scale. Louvre, Paris (MNR 727).

artworks.title: Helios Rising in His Quadriga (Attic lekythos)
artworks.description: On this black-figure lekythos Helios rises in his four-horse chariot while Nyx and Eos drive away — the sun god's daily birth painted for an Attic grave. Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York.

popCulture.title: Colossus of Rhodes
popCulture.description: The lost bronze wonder of the ancient world was a colossal Helios — the sun god as harbour guardian, and still the image that makes his name monumental.

popCulture.title: Percy Jackson & the Olympians
popCulture.creator: Rick Riordan
popCulture.description: Riordan's demigod series keeps Helios among the fading Titan-era suns — the chariot of day as a power the modern gods have partly replaced.
